SPECIAL ELECTION FOR RENEWAL
AND CONTINUATION OF LEVY OF THE
5.5 MILL COUNTYWIDE SCHOOL TAX
(Section 269.01, Constitution of Alabama
of 2022)
Shall the governing body of Franklin
County, Alabama, be authorized to levy
annually, for a period of thirty (30)
consecutive years, commencing with the
levy for the tax year that will begin on
October 1, 2027 (for which tax year taxes
will become due and payable on October
1, 2028), for public school purposes in
said county, a special property tax at the
rate of fifty-five cents on each one
hundred dollars (equal to 5.5 mills on
each dollar) of the assessed value of the
taxable property in said county, which
special tax shall be in renewal and
continuation of the special tax at the
same rate and for the same purpose that
is now being levied in the said county?
FOR proposed taxation
AGAINST proposed taxation

whatItDoes:
SPECIAL COUNTY ELECTION
MOBILE COUNTY, ALABAMA
Shall Mobile County in the State of
Alabama be authorized to issue from time
to time and in one or more series its
Pay-As-You-Go Road, Bridge and
Drainage Facilities Bonds, not exceeding
$82,000,000 in principal amount, for the
purpose of raising funds for the
construction and improvement, or either,
of hard surfaced roads, hard surfaced
bridges, and surface water drainage
facilities, or any thereof in the county,
which bonds shall bear interest at a rate
or rates to be fixed when they are sold,
not exceeding eight percent (8%) per
annum, payable semiannually until their
respective maturities, and shall mature
and become payable on December 1 in
the aggregate principal amount of
$8,200,000 in each of the years 2030
through 2039, and shall the said county
be authorized to continue to levy annually
a special tax, on all taxable property in
the county, at a rate not exceeding six
and one-half mills on each dollar of the
assessed valuation of such property, for
the purpose of paying at their respective
maturities the principal of and interest on
the said bonds and all other bonds at any
time outstanding which may be payable
out of or constitute a charge on the said
special tax, all pursuant to the provisions
of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022,
Local Provisions Section 49-3.00, as
amended, and Section 49-3.11?
FOR
said proposed Mobile County
Pay-As-You-Go Road, Bridge and
Drainage Facilities Bonds and the said
proposed continued levy of the said
special tax.
AGAINST
said proposed Mobile County
Pay-As-You-Go Road, Bridge and
Drainage Facilities Bonds and the said
proposed continued levy of the said
special tax.

whatItDoes:
RENEWAL AND CONTINUATION OF
THE LEVY OF 9 MILLS OF AD
VALOREM TAX
SPECIAL ELECTION FOR RENEWAL
AND CONTINUATION OF THE LEVY OF
9 MILLS OF AD VALOREM TAX FOR
PUBLIC SCHOOL AND GENERAL
COUNTY PURPOSES
(Section 66-10.00 and Section 217(f),
Constitution of Alabama of 2022)
Shall the governing body of Wilcox
County, Alabama, in order to renew,
continue and preserve the current rate of
ad valorem taxation in the County, be
authorized to levy and collect, at the rate
of 19 mills per dollar ($1.90 per $100) of
the assessed value of taxable property in
the County, the special ad valorem tax
provided for under Section 66-10.00 of
the Constitution of Alabama of 2022,
which authorization, if approved, will
effect an increase in the rate of said tax of
9 mills; said increase to be allocated and
apportioned (i) 7 mills to the Wilcox
County Board of Education for public
school purposes and (ii) 2 mills to Wilcox
County for deposit into the general fund
of the County; said increase to be
effective for each tax year of the County
commencing with the tax year that will
begin on October 1, 2027 (for which taxes
will become due and payable on October
1, 2028); and said increase to become
effective simultaneous with expiration of a
9-mill special ad valorem tax levied in the
County for the benefit of the said Board of
Education and the County, all to the end
that there be no net increase in the
present rate of taxation in the County?
FOR proposed taxation
AGAINST proposed taxation
